pages.title: Stumble Boys: Party Royale
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Compete through a changing set of minigames in Stumble Boys: Party Royale. Each round chooses another event, so be ready to switch from racing to a different survival challenge. Stay in contention as the colorful party contest keeps changing around the players.

pages.title: Blockibo: Color Blocks
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Move colored pieces toward their gates in Blockibo: Color Blocks. Clear the route for trapped blocks and work around obstacles that limit your next move. Use boosters when they can open a difficult part of the board, then send every piece through its exit.

pages.title: Moto Traffic Rider
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Weave through highway traffic on six superbikes in Moto Traffic Rider. Try three modes and use replenishing nitro to get past slower vehicles. Upgrade your bike as you explore the three highway settings and work on avoiding collisions at higher speeds.

pages.title: Robberies 3D
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Carry out a heist in Robberies 3D. Search for keys, drill into secure areas and get access to the vault before taking the loot. Choose a quieter approach or fight your way through with weapons as you work past the defenses.

pages.title: Puzzle Masters: Travelers
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Reconstruct landscape pictures in Puzzle Masters: Travelers. Move the pieces into place before time runs out and use boosters when a section is hard to solve. Unlock more locations as the completed images build a journey around the world.

pages.title: Pet Tile Master
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Find triples of matching pets in Pet Tile Master. Pick tiles into a holding stack with room for nine, making sets before it fills. Look for matches that uncover more useful pieces so you can clear the whole arrangement.

pages.title: Nonogram Master
pages.creator: in8finity
pages.description: Reveal pixel pictures in Nonogram Master by interpreting the numbers around the grid. Fill the cells that belong to each run and mark known blanks with an X. Choose the control style you prefer as you solve the Japanese-crossword layouts.

pages.title: Block Puzzle Travel
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Fit pieces into boards and clear blocks in Block Puzzle Travel. Focus on the diamond blocks and the objective for each stage while planning where new pieces can go. Build a stronger result by keeping the board open for later moves.

pages.title: Little Commander. Red vs Blue
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Develop a military camp in Little Commander. Red vs Blue. Recruit soldiers, build tanks and vehicles and lead the crowd into battle. Balance attacks with protection for the camp, improving the army as you gain the resources to expand.

pages.title: Count Escape Rush
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Run backward while firing at pursuing enemies in Count Escape Rush. Collect extra squad members and weapons, then choose routes that help your force survive. Keep the incoming red fighters under control until your group can reach the finish.

pages.title: Magic Finger Puzzle 3d
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Use a pair of powerful hands to escape traps in Magic Finger Puzzle 3d. Fire a laser to break cages or launch objects into useful positions. Create a safe route over spikes and other barriers before moving the character onward.

pages.title: Max Mixed Cocktails
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Experiment behind a bar in Max Mixed Cocktails. Choose ingredients, blend them and taste the result to reveal one of the different endings. Check the collection's clues when you want to work toward a recipe you have not discovered.

pages.title: Ellie And Friends Get Ready For First Date
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Choose evening looks for a group of friends in Ellie And Friends Get Ready For First Date. Browse clothes and accessories for each girl and coordinate the pieces for her outing. Give everyone a distinct look before the dates begin.

pages.title: Monster Truck Crazy Racing 2
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Race a monster truck in a dirt arena in Monster Truck Crazy Racing 2. Drive with WASD and use the boost when you have a clear run. Keep the vehicle steady through the rougher sections and reset it if it gets stuck.

pages.title: Solitaire Mahjong Classic 2
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Clear traditional tile layouts in Solitaire Mahjong Classic 2. Pair free matching tiles and choose removals that reveal more of the board. Explore over 135 puzzles and change between ivory and wooden tile styles as you play.

pages.title: My Stylish Ball Gown
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Help a group dress for a formal party in My Stylish Ball Gown. Try different gowns and costume pieces on each friend, then add the accessories that suit the outfit. Compare the finished looks before the gathering starts.

pages.title: Enchanted Waters
pages.creator: Advergame Technologies Private Limited
pages.description: Time jumps through a watery maze in Enchanted Waters. Watch where the path ends and tap to reach the next platform before the runner falls into the lake. Keep the timing steady as the narrow route changes ahead.

pages.title: Pirate Girls Treasure Hunting
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Prepare adventurers for a search in Pirate Girls Treasure Hunting. Choose pirate clothes, jewelry and swords first, then use magnifying glasses to look for the treasure box. Complete both the styling and hidden-object activities along the way.

pages.title: Gangster Shooting Police Game
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Complete timed urban missions in Gangster Shooting Police Game. Move through the city, find the current objective and deal with enemies standing in the way. Keep track of the countdown while trying to survive the gang conflict.

pages.title: Snowboard Master 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Carve down snowy courses in Snowboard Master 3D. Move left and right, carry speed around turns and jump when the route calls for it. Use the props you collect to disrupt other racers while trying to beat them to the finish.

pages.title: Street Rider
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Customize a car and enter busy roads in Street Rider. Choose one-way or two-way traffic and steer through openings without hitting other vehicles. Get familiar with your car's handling before attempting a longer high-speed run.

pages.title: Halloween Mahjong
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Connect matching holiday tiles in Halloween Mahjong. Look for clear routes between identical pictures and use each removed pair to open more of the board. Use Hint or Shuffle if the remaining tiles leave no obvious connection.

pages.title: Gems Shot
pages.creator: Gamebol
pages.description: Send gems toward the target spaces in Gems Shot. Choose a moment when colored obstacles are out of the way and let the shot pass through. Keep working on your timing as the level setups become harder to clear.

pages.title: Geometry Jump
pages.creator: GM Media
pages.description: Jump through three geometric obstacle courses in Geometry Jump. Watch for spikes and other shapes along the route and tap with enough time to clear them. Learn the difficult sections as you try to make it through each level.

pages.title: Truck Driver Simulator
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Carry military supplies over mountain roads in Truck Driver Simulator. Complete ten transport missions under a time limit, balancing the need for speed with keeping the truck stable. Brake before tight sections so the load can reach its destination.

pages.title: Candy Revolution
pages.creator: TWO PLAYERS GAME STUDIO
pages.description: Drag through matching candies in Candy Revolution to remove groups of three or more. Longer connections score more, so check the nearby pieces before making a short chain. Keep producing matches while the timer runs.

pages.title: Home Pipe Water Puzzle
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Connect pipes through cartoon household scenes in Home Pipe Water Puzzle. Work out which sections need to join and turn them into a usable water route. Finish more layouts to open additional character skins.

pages.title: Giant Snowball Rush
pages.creator: PL Studio
pages.description: Push a growing snowball toward the finish in Giant Snowball Rush. Avoid obstacles and collect coins or props along the track, remembering that a larger snowball is harder to steer. Try to arrive with the biggest ball you can manage.

pages.title: Cat Escape
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Sneak a cat out of guarded rooms in Cat Escape. Watch the security patrols before dragging the character across open space. Move through the house without being spotted as you search for the way out.

pages.title: BFF Two Piece Trends
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Choose holiday swimwear for Clara, Sophie and Ava in BFF Two Piece Trends. Put together a two-piece outfit for each princess and add a cover-up or accessories. Give the group vacation looks that work with their individual styles.

pages.title: Rowing 2 Sculls
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Pick one of six crews and race twelve courses in Rowing 2 Sculls. Tap at the right moments to coordinate strong strokes and keep the boat ahead of the competitors. Finish first to advance to the next event.

pages.title: Dont Jeopardize This
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Choose a category and work out the question behind each answer in Dont Jeopardize This. Build your winnings through topics such as geography, science and holidays. Reach the final round to try for the game show's top result.

pages.title: Desert Racer Monster Truck
pages.creator: Pro_Gaming
pages.description: Race trucks through ten desert stages in Desert Racer Monster Truck. Collect coins and spend them on vehicles with improved performance from the eight-truck selection. Work toward opening new levels as you learn the terrain.

pages.title: Lick Them all
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Hold to extend a tongue and release to pull it back in Lick Them all. Taste safe objects along the route and withdraw before reaching hazards such as ice or hot spices. Time the action as the course moves underneath.

pages.title: Critical Strike Global Ops
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Enter online deathmatches in Critical Strike Global Ops. Move through the map, buy a weapon and take on rival players with modern firearms. Keep track of ammunition and use cover while setting up your next shot.

pages.title: Escape from Prison
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Choose actions to guide a stick figure out of jail in Escape from Prison. Each option leads to a different result, including failed escapes. Retry after a wrong turn and explore the choices until you find a route that works.

pages.title: Virtual Families Cook Off
pages.creator: Gogii Games
pages.description: Cook for a stream of guests in Virtual Families Cook Off. Prepare dishes such as burgers, pizza or sushi and serve them before the rush gets ahead of you. Manage several cooking tasks so the next order is ready when needed.

pages.title: Happy Halloween Memory
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Turn over magical cards in Happy Halloween Memory. Learn where the pictures are and uncover matching pairs to help the young witch complete her protective ritual. Keep using earlier reveals to finish the remaining cards with fewer guesses.

pages.title: Toy Trucks Coloring
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Pick a vehicle picture in Toy Trucks Coloring and fill it with colors from the palette. Work through eight drawings with twenty-three shades available, then save your finished truck. Color quickly when you want a stronger score.

pages.title: Brick Out Adventure
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Bounce a ball into colorful bricks in Brick Out Adventure. Move the paddle to catch each return and collect items dropped by destroyed blocks. Pick up clocks to extend the round while you clear the remaining bricks.

pages.title: Happy Family Coloring Book
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Color a scene of relatives spending time together in Happy Family Coloring Book. Choose an image and paint the details with your own palette. Save the completed drawing when you want to keep it or show it afterward.

pages.title: Candy Fever
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Fill the container with sweets in Candy Fever. Keep producing candies until they reach the target line, watching how they settle as the pile grows. Complete one fill to unlock the next level.

pages.title: Fast Euro Train Driver Sim
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Control a passenger train in Fast Euro Train Driver Sim. Operate the driving controls and follow the route between the requested stops. Manage acceleration and braking as you work through the simulator's railway tasks.

pages.title: Fun Race 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Race other characters through obstacle courses in Fun Race 3D. Time your movement to pass the hazards and reach the finish ahead of the rivals. Collect new skins and celebratory dances as you continue competing.

pages.title: The Cinderella Story Puzzle
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Rebuild pictures from a fairy tale in The Cinderella Story Puzzle. Fit together scenes featuring Cinderella, her magical pumpkin and the fairy who helps her. Use the outlines and colors to match the pieces and reveal each complete illustration.

pages.title: Water Shooty
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Take cover during a water-gun fight in Water Shooty. Move between the barriers and aim at opponents when they are exposed. Use the bunkers to avoid their shots while working toward a higher score in the round.

pages.title: Black Star Pinball
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Use the pinball to collect gold stars in Black Star Pinball. Each target stays for eighteen seconds, so direct the ball toward it before it vanishes. Watch for the black stars that appear later and keep them out of the ball's path.

pages.title: Candy Cake
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Make a decorated dessert in Candy Cake. Follow the kitchen instructions to prepare the cake, then finish it with colorful sweets and chocolate details. Work through the recipe until the festive cake is ready to serve.

pages.title: Tank Defender
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Defend your ground from aircraft in Tank Defender. Fire at the attackers while moving away from dropped bombs, then collect supply boxes from friendly planes. Keep the tank operating for as long as you can against the invasion.

pages.title: Lampada Street
pages.creator: Vardan Aleksanyan
pages.description: Guide walking light bulbs across busy roads in Lampada Street. Get one of the three bulbs to the destination to advance to another street. Press a key to run and use the space bar to jump as you head toward Lampada.

pages.title: Classic Sliding Numbers
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Slide numbered pieces into ascending order in Classic Sliding Numbers. Use the empty space to rearrange adjacent tiles and gradually bring each one to its proper position. Try to finish the whole board more quickly on your next attempt.

pages.title: Dungeon Box
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Keep a ball inside a three-walled enclosure in Dungeon Box. Tap just before it reaches the open bottom to create a temporary fourth wall. Time every rebound carefully, since the wall disappears again almost immediately.

pages.title: Flippy Hero
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Flip a hero through an enemy-filled course in Flippy Hero. Use the mouse or A and D to time movement and keep clear of the threats ahead. Pick up coins as you find openings to continue along the route.

pages.title: BTS Baby Girl Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Paint cheerful infant pictures in BTS Baby Girl Coloring. Pick the colors you want for the character and the smaller details around her. Experiment with unusual shades to make each drawing look different from the last.

pages.title: Number Merge
pages.creator: DiHits
pages.description: Link identical numbered pieces in Number Merge to create higher values. Look for a longer connection before spending a move, then use the merged result to set up another group. Continue while useful connections remain and work toward a larger score.

pages.title: Christmas Trucks Differences
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Compare festive vehicle scenes in Christmas Trucks Differences. Find seven changes in each pair before the timer ends, checking the trucks and the decorations around them. Work through ten levels of holiday pictures.

pages.title: Christmas Candy
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Aim colored sweets into matching groups in Christmas Candy. Bring three or more of a kind together to pop them and increase your score. Check which colors remain after each shot so you can open more space.

pages.title: Santa Gift Truck
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Drive Santa's vehicle over rough mountain routes in Santa Gift Truck. Collect presents while keeping the truck balanced across bumps and changing weather. Carry as many gifts as you can through the course for the children waiting around the world.

pages.title: Police Car Stunt Driver
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Explore ramps in a police vehicle in Police Car Stunt Driver. Build speed for jumps around the city or nearby off-road area, then try to land after a flip. Use the handbrake when you need a tighter maneuver.

pages.title: Christmas Spirit Memory
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Turn over holiday tiles in Christmas Spirit Memory. Remember the position of each picture and uncover identical ones together to keep the pair. Clear all four boards while trying to reduce the number of moves you use.

pages.title: Green Chick Jump
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Help a chicken run across gaps in Green Chick Jump. Tap to jump as an edge approaches and adjust to the faster pace as the run continues. Keep your timing accurate to go farther and improve the score.

pages.title: Sister S Halloween Dresses
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Choose party costumes for Emma, Mia and Bella in Sister S Halloween Dresses. Browse the outfit options and give each girl a style for Halloween. Add the finishing pieces before the three friends head to their celebration.

pages.title: Bear Chase Game Adventure
pages.creator: yaine
pages.description: Collect fish with a bear in Bear Chase Game Adventure. Watch the shadow following your earlier movements and find a route that keeps the bear away from it. Gather as much fish as you can without being caught.

pages.title: Defence Your Tower
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Build towers to stop an invasion in Defence Your Tower. Set up a defensive line that covers the approaching enemies and keep the attackers from reaching the kingdom. Choose the placements that make the best use of the available defenses.

pages.title: Mermaid Princess
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Explore an underwater city in Mermaid Princess. Join the mermaid in a series of sea-themed activities and work through the tasks presented at each stage. Discover more of her world as you complete the levels.

pages.title: Cool Cars Puzzle 2
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Restore six automobile pictures in Cool Cars Puzzle 2. Choose a piece count from sixteen to one hundred, then use the vehicle and background details to fit the scattered parts together. Complete the current scene before trying another car.

pages.title: Flappy Gull
pages.creator: Neuronality
pages.description: Keep a seagull in flight through gaps between tubes in Flappy Gull. Tap to lift it and leave enough room for the next opening as it descends. Avoid the pipes to extend the distance of your flight.

pages.title: Wedding Dress Up
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Create a bridal look in Wedding Dress Up. Browse dresses and accessories, trying different pieces until you have a coordinated outfit for the ceremony. Experiment with combinations to see how each choice changes the overall style.

pages.title: Easter Hurly Burly
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Use nonogram clues to uncover hidden eggs in Easter Hurly Burly. Interpret the numbered rows and columns, then mark the cells you have solved. Complete thirty boards with as few mistakes as possible to earn stars and achievements.

pages.title: Army Commando
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Fight through fifteen missions in Army Commando. Move, crouch and take aim against the opposing force, switching weapons or using grenades as needed. Watch your position before advancing into the next part of the battlefield.

pages.title: Candy Match3 Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Make sets of three matching candies in Candy Match3 Challenge. Reach the target score before you use up the available steps, with no time limit to hurry your decisions. Choose matches that leave another useful move on the board.

pages.title: Mountain Climb Racing
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Race over hills and mountain obstacles in Mountain Climb Racing. Control the vehicle through rises and landings as you challenge the computer or a friend. Keep enough speed to reach the finish before the other driver.

pages.title: Valentines Puzzle Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a romantic picture and rebuild it in Valentines Puzzle Challenge. Select easy, medium or hard difficulty and place the pieces by matching colors and edges. Solve the jigsaw at your own pace without a countdown.

pages.title: Stud Rider
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description: Ride a motorbike over hilly terrain in Stud Rider. Collect fuel to keep moving and use the left and right controls to manage flips. Land with the wheels aligned so the rider can carry on to the next slope.

pages.title: Princesses Double Boho Wedding
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Style two brides for a shared ceremony in Princesses Double Boho Wedding. Choose bohemian dresses, hair details and accessories that suit both friends. Give the two princesses individual looks within the same wedding theme.

pages.title: Hero Simulator
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Develop an adventurer in Hero Simulator. Earn resources through the available activities and invest them in the warrior's progress. Keep improving the character so it can take on more of the challenges the world offers.

pages.title: Alchemy Master
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Experiment with elements in Alchemy Master. Bring materials such as wind and fire together and see which combinations produce another discovery. Use the growing collection of ingredients to keep uncovering new results.

pages.title: High School Perfect Couples!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Take Ellie and Annie shopping in High School Perfect Couples! Browse the dresses and help each princess choose a look for time with her boyfriend. Coordinate the rest of the outfit once you have selected the dress.

pages.title: Barbie Winter Glam
pages.creator: Bitent Media
pages.description: Put together cold-weather looks in Barbie Winter Glam. Explore the fashion choices gathered for a winter shopping trip and try different garments together. Finish with details that suit the outfit before Barbie heads into town.

pages.title: Dove Carnival Dolly Dress Up H5
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Open mystery boxes to style Dove in Dove Carnival Dolly Dress Up H5. Pick a dress and shoes from the items inside, then add a mask to suit the carnival. Compare the combinations before completing her look for the evening.
